entities.name: Bragi
entities.description:
Bragi is the Norse god of poetry and eloquence. He had runes carved on his tongue and gave humans the Mead of Poetry.

Bragi was rather a minor character in Marvel comics, he only appeared on 2 issues.thumb|One of Bragi's appearances in Marvel comics.

entities.name: Heimdall
entities.description:
Heimdall is the guardian of Asgard, he guards the Bifrost bridge. He blows his horn when Ragnarok comes. He's also an Aesir. Heimdall can see and hear across time.

In Marvel, Heimdall has quite a big role. He's Sif's brother, which was real in Norse Mythology, and he weilds a sword capable of sending waves of energy called the Uru blade. His horn is called Gjallarhorn. When other gods visit other realms, they have to call Heimdall's name and Heimdall will send them back to Asgard.

entities.name: Loki
entities.description:
Loki is a god and a Jotunn, but generally he's a god. In that case he's the god of mischief and tricks. He's known to give the Asgardians problems.thumb|Portrayed by Tom Hiddleston.thumb

In Marvel, Loki is Thor's half brother, He's a frost giant and he has a sceptor, capable of mind control. In Marvel he also has a wife called Sigyn. He was confined once to a punishment because he killed Balder, so he was tied to to a rock and a snake would drip venom on him. Loki is a neutral character in Marvel, sometimes a villain and sometimes a hero.

Children: Hel, Svaoilfari, Fenrir and Jormungandr.

entities.name: Odin
entities.description:
Odin is the all father of all of the Norse gods and goddesses. He's the ruler of asgard and weilds an enchanted spear: Gungnir. He has 2 ravens called Huginn and Munin.

In Marvel, Odin adopted a frost giant infant called Loki. His spear Gungnir was actually just called "Odin's spear" in Marvel. HIs last name is Borson, he and Gaea the all mother had a child called Thor Odinson.

entities.name: Thor
entities.description:
Thor is the Norse god of Thunder, strength, power, oak trees and protector of humanity. He weilds the hammer Mjolnir. His height is six foot six. See Thor's Stolen Hammer.

Mjolnir was made by the dwarfs Sindri and Brokkr. It's capable of levelling mountains. To see the legend and creation/story of Mjolnir, see Skaldskaparmal.

In Marvel Comics, Mjolnir is made out of a dwarf star and is capable of teleportation and ripping the reality fabric of Marvel universe.

"Whoever holds this hammer, if he be worthy enough, shall possess the power of... THOR!"

entities.name: Valhalla
entities.description:
Valhalla could be seen right after you open the gates to Asgard. It has 540 wide doors and the roof is made of golden shields. Every morning warriors of Valhalla would go out to fight battles and return to Valhalla, it doesn't matter if any limbs were missing because at the end of the day they all will be restored.

In a mortal battle, Valkyries decides who lives and who dies in battle, they send dead warriors to Valhalla. They are female hosts and they ride on flying horses. They like to hover in the clouds above and watch a war and then judge.thumb|Valkyrie from marvel. Category:Places
